content:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked — staging pipeline failed for ci-image-build #782 (artifact verification failed)
alex: seeing checksum mismatch on upload step, S3 reported ETag mismatch for part 3
maya: attaching excerpt from job log: `multipart upload aborted: 403 Forbidden on PUT part`
sam: timeline: cache-pruner ran ~60s before upload started. Could be eviction and parallel upload race causing part retry to fail
ira: can we re-run with cache disabled to confirm? slow but safer for this window
alex: quick mitigation: we have last-known-good image digest sha256:abcd1234f9 available in registry, we can pin to that for the release window
maya: pinning adds a manifest bump and release-note entry, no DB migrations so low risk
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by policy: auto-promote disabled when artifact verify fails :no_entry_sign:
jamie: proposal: 1) pin to last-green digest for staging/canary, 2) abort current canary attempts, 3) run background full rebuild with --no-cache to reproduce
sam: +1 to that. Also opening infra task to increase multipart upload retries and investigate timing (INF-3910)
alex: I've prepared the release-notes blurb and a quick runbook patch; will apply pin after consensus
maya: smoke test plan on pinned image: run existing smoke suite in staging, should be quick
ira: agreed, also want a connectivity sweep to S3 region while background rebuild runs
jamie: ok, if smoke passes we can promote pinned image to canary in the 12:05 UTC change window
alex: initiating manual promote to pinned digest: `/deploy promote --image=sha256:abcd1234f9 --env=staging`
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Starting promote job 5832
sam: kicked off background rebuild with --no-cache on runner r05 (job 783)
maya: pinned image smoke tests started
jamie: keeping release notes: "Pin image to last-known-good digest due to artifact upload failures during CI. No code change."
ira: INF-3910 created: investigate cache-pruner timing + S3 part retry behaviour
alex: staging smoke on pinned image passed :white_check_mark:
jamie: scheduling canary promote for 1767780300 (12:05 UTC) and will manually confirm before prod promote
sam: background rebuild finished and... failed with same checksum mismatch, uploading logs to /logs/ci/783/part-mismatch.log
maya: if rebuild with no-cache also fails, likely transient S3 or network issue rather than cache TTL. Good we pinned
ira: SRE to run connectivity sweep and bump s3 client retries temporarily
alex: decision: hold prod promote, keep pinned image for release window until root cause determined and infra fixes applied
jamie: consensus recorded: pin for release window, delay production promote. I'll notify stakeholders and update cut notes
maya: added runbook steps: manual promote, rollback to pinned digest, link to INF-3910 in runbook
deploy-bot: Thread closed after pin decision by @jamie
